$comment: Model context overrides applied by apply.ps1 / apply.sh through the management
Needed where the gateway cannot resolve a model's real window and would fall back
to 128000: a client whose own limit is higher then gets its request rejected and
target uses the leg spelling the gateway routes; context is the model's documented
input window in tokens. Keep the list deliberate: add a row only when the gateway's
own resolution (registry / models.dev / provider discovery) is known to miss the
model - a manual row always wins over those, so a wrong row here would be silent.
Scope note: a row applies to the exact target spelling only. The gateway also
accepts namespace aliases (e.g. openai-compatible-chat/<model> for the meta-api
node connection); such live rows are harmless duplicates, not drift.
The vertex/gemini rows exist because the gateway's generic name heuristic resolves
any "gemini" model to 1,000,000 - 48k short of the real 1,048,576 the direct

overrides.$comment: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (MODEL deepseek-flash): 1M context per the vendor Models & Pricing page; registry models.deepseek-flash context_advertised 1048576. Measured 2026-09-30: without this the gateway served 128k and the live session compacted in a loop.

Meta Model API contributor tier: 1,048,576 in (registry models.muse-spark-1.3-contributor). The spark-1.3-contributor / t1-orchestrator-paid routes declare 1M. Measured 2026-09-30: without this the gateway served 128k.
Gemini 3 Flash (Vertex): 1M window. Serves the opencode hand entry vertex-flash (limit 1048576).
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (Vertex): 1M window. Serves the opencode hand entry vertex-flash-lite.
Gemini 3.1 Pro (Vertex): 1M window. Serves the opencode hand entry vertex-pro.
Gemini 3.8 Flash (Vertex, enabled in the operator's project 2026-09-30): 1M window. Serves the opencode hand entry vertex-3.8-flash.
Gemini 2.5 Flash (Vertex): 1M window. Serves the opencode hand entry gemini-2.5-flash.
